Where each county estimate comes from: county x year x source CoC

Source: R/county_coc_alloc.R
county_coc_alloc.Rd

The exact apportionment behind homeless, county_pit and county_pit_detail: for every county and year, each CoC whose PIT count contributed to the county's estimate and how many people it contributed. Use it to trace a county figure to its sources, to see which year's HUD boundary placed it, or to explain a large year-over-year swing (a change of source CoC, or of a CoC's footprint, moves a county's estimate even when no CoC's count changed much).

Usage

county_coc_alloc

Format

A data frame with one row per county-year-CoC and 7 variables:

fips

5-digit county FIPS code.

year

Year.

coc_num

Contributing CoC.

count

People apportioned to this county from this CoC.

role

"primary": the CoC covering the largest part of the county (at least 1% of it). "nested": a sub-county CoC (e.g. Long Beach inside Los Angeles County) assigned whole to the county holding most of it. "bridged": the county's own CoC in a year when HUD's boundary file leaves the county out, though the CoC holds it in the years before and after (e.g. Yuba County in CA-524, 2011-2014); without this the county would be imputed on top of its CoC's count. "bi-state": the Kansas portion of Kansas City's CoC (MO-604), split by HUD's published state totals.

share

Share of the county's area the CoC covers in that year's boundary file (below 1% or 0 for bridged rows; NA for bi-state rows and nested CoCs in a county with its own primary).

boundary_year

Year of the HUD boundary file used to place the CoC. Differs from year when HUD's file for year omits the CoC; the nearest year's polygon is used (53 CoC-years, e.g. CA-524 2009-2012, LA-509 2007-2014).

Source

Built by data-raw/05_county_estimates.R. Method: Almquist, Helwig and You (2020) <doi:10.1080/08898480.2019.1636574>.

Details

Summing count by coc_num and year reproduces every CoC's HUD count exactly (territory CoCs excepted: they have no counties). Summing by fips and year reproduces homeless_na, except for a handful of counties lowered by the per-capita cap. Counties absent in a year had no CoC and were imputed.
